original_qualifier_definitions.A: Approved for publication -- Processing and review completed.

numerical_method.decimal_sums: Original decimal values summed with exact safe integers before division
numerical_method.percentiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p on ascending daily values; percentile05 is the low-flow fifth percentile
numerical_method.full_period_totals: Calculated only when every expected calendar date has a valid original daily mean
numerical_method.qualified_values: Original approved, provisional, estimated and revised records are retained with their agency flags
numerical_method.stage: Stage observations retain feet and their own original gage reference
numerical_method.nutrient_flow_join: Identical calendar reporting date at the upstream Eighteenmile gauge; original sample station and project retained
numerical_method.nutrient_censor_context: Quantified concentrations retain their values; below-quantification rows retain 0-to-limit bounds and an explicit half-limit context value
numerical_method.nitrogen: Unfiltered Kjeldahl nitrogen plus unfiltered nitrate/nitrite within the same original activity
